title: Bean Box Alternatives: 6 Coffee Subscriptions From Tasting Flights to Pods
summary: Looking for a Bean Box alternative? Compare six coffee subscriptions by price, variety, and format, from two-origin boxes and tasting flights to pods.
body_markdown:
## The alternatives


Closest match on Cratejoy


### MyBean Monthly vs Bean Box


1st box


50% off


Editor's Picks 2024


[MyBean Monthly](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/mybean) by MyBean


From $26.17 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/mybean)


**Best for:** The Bean Box subscriber whose favorite part was tasting one origin against another.


MyBean, a veteran-owned seller, sends two single-origin coffees each month, 12 oz between them, with tasting notes, brewing tips, and a few fun facts about where the beans grew. One subscriber's first box paired Ethiopia with Kenya.


#### What feels familiar


Bean Box's Single Origin plan and its sampler gifts are built around comparing origins. MyBean puts that comparison in every box.


#### What changes


Two coffees share 12 oz, so you get less of each, and the price per ounce runs higher than Bean Box's single bag. You don't choose a roast profile, and boxes ship once a month instead of on a schedule you set.


Costs less than Bean Box


### Bell Lap Coffee vs Bean Box


[Monthly Coffee Subscription - (1) 12 oz. bag per month](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/bell-lap-coffee) by Bell Lap Coffee


From $11.95 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/bell-lap-coffee)


**Best for:** Drinking one reliable roast every morning for a lower monthly price.


Bell Lap roasts to order and ships within 48 hours of roasting. Order by 6 pm Central on a Monday, and your coffee roasts Tuesday and ships Wednesday. Pick a French roast, a Vienna roast, a medium, a light, the roaster's choice, or a Swiss Water decaf.


#### What feels familiar


Choosing a roast works much like picking Dark & Toasty or Light & Bright on Bean Box, and both ship coffee within days of roasting.


#### What changes


It's one roaster with a set lineup, so the new-coffee-every-time part of Bean Box goes away unless you choose Roaster's Choice or change roasts. Bell Lap grinds coarse, medium, or fine, where Bean Box's ground option uses one all-purpose grind.


A gift that gives back


### Puppy Paws Cup of the Month vs Bean Box


1st box


20% off


Preferred Seller


[COFFEE - Cup of the Month club](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/brew-of-the-month-coffee-puppypawscoffeecompany) by Puppy Paws Coffee & Tea Company


From $24.49 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/brew-of-the-month-coffee-puppypawscoffeecompany)


**Best for:** Gifting coffee to someone who'd like the purchase to help animal rescues.


Each box holds a 12 oz bag, whole bean or ground, flavored or not, plus a small extra the seller calls a lagniappe. Puppy Paws Coffee & Tea Company donates 10% of every purchase to animal rescue.


#### What feels familiar


A 12 oz bag a month is the same shape as Bean Box's Coffee of the Month gift, and Puppy Paws sells prepaid 3-, 6-, and 12-month plans for gifting too.


#### What changes


The seller picks the coffee, and there's no preview-and-swap before it ships. The first box goes out within seven days of ordering, then between the 10th and 20th of each month.


For a Keurig


### Tayst coffee pods vs Bean Box


Preferred Seller


[Tayst | Keurig Compatible Pods | Compostable & Biodegradable Single Serve Keurig Coffee Pods | Gourmet Coffee in Earth Friendly Packaging](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/tayst-keurig-compatible-pods-compostable-biodegradable-single-serve-keurig-coffee-pods-gourmet-coffee-in-earth-friendly-packaging-taystcoffee) by Tayst Coffee


From $26.55 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/tayst-keurig-compatible-pods-compostable-biodegradable-single-serve-keurig-coffee-pods-gourmet-coffee-in-earth-friendly-packaging-taystcoffee)


**Best for:** A Keurig household that still wants to try several coffees.


Tayst makes Keurig-compatible pods that are compostable and contain no plastic, filled with Rainforest Alliance Certified coffee. The Bold, Medium, and Flavor Samplers and the Variety Pack mix several blends in one box, in sizes from 30 to 240 pods.


#### What feels familiar


Bean Box sells sampler sets of two to four bags as gifts. Tayst's sampler packs bring the same try-a-few idea to a single-cup brewer.


#### What changes


Bean Box plans come as whole bean or ground, so pods are the reason to switch here. You trade bags from many roasters for pre-ground blends from one.


More roasters to meet


### Trade Coffee vs Bean Box


**Best for:** The Bean Box fan who wants an even longer list of roasters, matched by a taste quiz.


[Trade Coffee](https://www.drinktrade.com/) matches you with coffees from independent US roasters, with more than 450 on its Signature plan and 100-plus on a lower-priced plan of classics. Each order is a different coffee unless you set a favorite to repeat.


#### What feels familiar


This is the closest outside match: many small roasters, picks based on your taste, and an email a few days before each order so you can make changes.


#### What changes


A standard Trade bag holds 10.93 oz, a little less than Bean Box's 12. Shipping is $3.99 per bag when you pay as you go and free on prepaid bundles of 3, 6, or 12 bags. Each roaster ships on its own schedule, so timing varies. We compared Trade with other subscriptions in our[Trade Coffee alternatives](https://www.cratejoy.com/blogs/box-insider/boxes-like-trade-coffee) guide.


A tasting flight first


### Driftaway Coffee vs Bean Box


**Best for:** Learning what you like before you settle on a profile.


[Driftaway Coffee](https://store.driftaway.coffee/collections/subscriptions) , a Brooklyn roaster, lets you open a subscription with an Explorer Box: five coffees, 4 oz each, from light to dark, plus a free virtual tasting you can join live or do on your own. Afterward you pick your favorite profiles, and shipments rotate through them.


#### What feels familiar


Bean Box's Discovery Samplers do the tasting-flight part. Driftaway builds your whole subscription from one.


#### What changes


Everything comes from one roaster, so the variety is in origins and roast levels, not different roasting companies. Deliveries can run as often as weekly, a faster schedule than any Bean Box plan.
